name: SethBot-MD
description: SethBot-MD WhatsApp Bot — deployable to Heroku and other Node.js hosting panels

SESSION_ID.description: Paste your TELMAS~ session ID here (generate it on the SethBot-MD pairing website first)

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner's WhatsApp number, with country code, no + or spaces (e.g. 254700000000)

PAIR_SERVER_URL.description: Your SethBot-MD pairing server, used by the .pair command (optional)

PORT.description: Port for the built-in web server (Heroku sets this automatically)
